title: Read the native vector-motion catalog
summary: Read the existing native vector-motion Point Library catalog or descriptor without installing a Project library, rendering motion or granting a write. The adapter checks native version and semantic contract identity. A layer may bring the library's data: the read then answers with the layer's version, catalog and verification, and with the layer off, with Lumeri's own.

carrier.notes: Reached through luc_invoke after discovery and description. Schemas describe the result before the wrapper; Runtime context and authority are supplied separately by the Host. A layer names its data on the capability as library {version, catalog, verification}.

replaceability.why: The Luc pins the existing native PointLibraryPackage. Its dispatcher is in-process gemia code supplied only by trusted Host bindings; the new open library/v1 recipe protocol is a different carrier. The code stays behind trusted Host bindings until the code sandbox (Acrab, 2026-10-24). A layer may bring the library's data in its place: installing a point library is laying a layer on this Luc, and taking it off brings Lumeri's own back (Acrab, 2026-10-24, decision 3A). Such a layer adds only the catalog and verification its capability names and changes no pin.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, 2026-10-24 (code behind trusted Host bindings until the code sandbox; decision 3A, a .lup is a data layer on this Luc); today's code: lumeri_runtime/luc_interface_gate.py:36-39

operations.name: read_native_catalog
operations.notes: No timeout is enforced on the in-process dispatch. Missing/falsy op defaults to catalog; op is stringified, stripped and lowercased; describe returns the same payload. Unknown operations return applied=false/E_ARG as data; create, adjust and apply raise the read-only refusal. Other input keys are accepted and ignored by the read path. Repeated reads leave the native catalog unchanged. With a layer, the answer is the native answer with the layer's version, catalog and verification; a layer whose data changed after load is refused (E_LUC_LIBRARY_CHANGED).

bounds.name: agent_result_chars
bounds.unit: characters before the model result is clipped; the cut notice is appended

bounds.name: layer_catalog_bytes
bounds.unit: bytes of a layer's catalog file

bounds.name: layer_verification_bytes
bounds.unit: bytes of a layer's verification file

invariants.text: create, adjust and apply never enter the native renderer through this adapter.
With a layer on, catalog and describe answer with the layer's version, catalog and verification in the native answer's shape; with it switched off or taken away, the native answer.
A layer adds only the catalog and verification files its library names, changes no file of the Luc and no pin; any other layer is left off and the native library answers.
A layer the agent would read in a language other than English is left off (E_LUC_LANGUAGE).

break: The trusted binding is absent, changed or refuses the invocation.
An input, result or Host context fails validation.
A layer's data fails its check at load: the layer is left off and the native library answers.
A layer's data changed after load: the read is refused (E_LUC_LIBRARY_CHANGED).
failure.notes: Disabling this Official Luc removes its capability. There is no automatic native substitute or unlayered-original retry at this invocation seam. A layer that does not load lies on nothing, and the Luc answers as it shipped.

conformance.notes: Both files ran for this change. Structural checking does not establish live availability or GUI acceptance.

known_deviations.text: The loaded adapter publishes only an object output schema. The structured catalog and returned native error are therefore not checked against their real shapes yet.

items.description: Native entry identities, parameters and verification metadata are preserved exactly as the registered catalog supplies them.
